citations.text: The scanned entry identifies 上 as an indicative graph: oracle forms place a short horizontal mark above a longer line to indicate the upper position. It describes Spring-and-Autumn forms with an added vertical stroke, varied Warring States forms, and the original spatial sense contrasted with 下. I inspected the supplied scan pixels: the 上 headword, glyph sequence and labels, and the prose through the entry’s end; page 15 begins 帝, so this is not a continuation. The listed underlying glyph dictionaries were not separately consulted. No OCR error was found.
